category: observability platform for logs, metrics, traces and RUM (hosted)

free_tier.stated: No recurring free tier on OpenObserve Cloud: a 14-day free trial of the Pay As You Go plan with no credit card required to start; afterwards USD 0.50 per GB ingested and USD 0.01 per GB queried, with 15 months of metrics and 30 days of logs, traces and RUM included
free_tier.notes: The Cloud free tier was discontinued on 2 June 2025 and replaced by usage-based pricing with a 14-day trial for new accounts. The repository README still says the Cloud free tier includes up to 50 GB a day of ingestion, which the pricing page and the policy post do not; the 50 GB a day free allowance on the pricing page belongs to the self-hosted Enterprise edition.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-event or per-log-line size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: 15 months of metrics and 30 days of logs, traces, RUM and other non-metrics data are included by default; further 30-day periods of non-metrics retention cost USD 0.02 per GB

egress.terms: queries are billed at USD 0.01 per GB queried; no charge on data read out other than the query volume is stated on the pages read

interface_detail: REST APIs for ingestion, search and management on the account's own host, authenticated by HTTP basic authentication with a base64 encoded user and password.
tooling: the web app and the REST APIs. Last resort, after every hosted offer: the Open Source edition (AGPL-3.0) is free forever and the Self-Hosted Enterprise edition is free up to 50 GB of ingestion a day, and the user installs and runs the server on a rented or free machine.
chaining: Logs, metrics and traces of a free-hosted app in one place for 14 days, then pay per GB with no seat or host fees.

limits.value: 14-day trial window, then pay as you go
USD 0.50 per GB ingested and USD 0.01 per GB queried after the trial

binding_note: The 14-day trial ends before any quota matters, and a valid credit card is needed to continue on Pay As You Go.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing FAQ states no credit card is required to start the 14-day trial; a valid credit card on file is needed after the trial, as the policy post states for former free-tier accounts. The sign-up fields are unverified: the cloud sign-in page is behind a login wall.

reliability_note: After the trial the account needs a credit card on file and is billed on usage; the Cloud free tier was discontinued with a 30-day exemption in June 2025.
confidence_note: The trial, the prices and the discontinued free tier are quoted from first-party pages; the README line that contradicts them is recorded as evidence. No account was opened.
